Compare CNC machining quotations

Compare prices for the same drawing revision, model, material grade, finish, quantity, required arrival date and acceptance records. Record substitutions or geometry changes as alternatives. Put excluded finishing, inspection records and delivery beside the price before choosing a supplier.

Compare what the price includes
Check	Compare across quotations	Question to resolve
Drawing and quantity	Part number, revision, units and quantity per line.	Is this price for the current revision and requested quantity?
Material	Grade, condition, substitutions and required records.	Is the specified material included, or is an alternative proposed?
Machining and finish	Required features, treatments, masking and final dimensions.	Which operations or treatments are excluded?
Setup and other charges	Programming, setup, tooling and special documentation where quoted separately.	Which charges are one-time, recurring or dependent on a repeat order?
Inspection	Features checked, sampling, methods and report format.	Are the requested acceptance records included?
Packing and transport	Surface protection, pack labels, delivery term and named place.	Who pays for transport, clearance, duties and taxes?
Schedule	Production start conditions, dispatch and transit assumptions.	Does the quoted time end at completion, dispatch or arrival?
Commercial terms	Currency, payment stages, quote validity and treatment of changes.	Which terms need written agreement before the order?
Resolve exceptions before awarding the order

Ask for missing items to be confirmed in writing. Keep the original requirement, proposed exception and agreed decision together. Do not assume an omitted inspection record or finish is included.

When comparing total cost, include the quoted separate charges and delivery responsibilities. Do not invent an allowance for an unquoted item: request a revised quote. An earlier sample does not automatically cover a changed drawing or material.

Review inspection planning
Keep the agreed scope with the order

Record the accepted quotation reference and date, drawing revision, quantity, approved exceptions and delivery basis. Agree how later changes will affect price, schedule and acceptance. LZZ’s order process explains the points to confirm from drawing review through delivery.

Privacy and site information

How inquiry drafts are stored and how to use the product information on this site.

Your inquiry

The inquiry form creates an email draft in your browser. It does not send your information to LZZ or upload drawings. To contact us, open the draft in your email app, add your attachments and send it yourself.

Saved drafts

Your input is kept in this browser tab so you can continue after a refresh. The draft is associated with the part or topic used when you entered the form. Changing the product or service inside the form updates that same draft; it does not create a separate saved copy. These details are not sent to LZZ or saved to an account.

Select “Clear saved input” to remove the draft for the current entry context, including older copies associated with that entry. A browser that restores an earlier session may also restore your draft. Clear your input when using a shared device.

If storage is blocked or full, you can still prepare a draft while the page is open, then choose “Save draft” to keep a text copy.

Cookies and external services

This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Your email provider, WhatsApp and other linked websites have their own privacy policies.

Product and company information

Product pages describe example parts and the information needed to quote a similar component. They are not independently verified specifications for the pictured parts. Your drawing and quotation define the material and tolerances, with inspection and commercial terms confirmed for your order. Original catalog records are retained in our archive.

The engineering guides help you prepare an inquiry. They contain no customer inspection results and do not establish suitability for a particular application. English summaries explain the company documents; contact LZZ to verify their current validity. Inspection planning is agreed for your order.

Hangzhou Lizhizao Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. For questions about this site, contact

Privacy and site information

How inquiry drafts are stored and how to use the product information on this site.

Your inquiry

The inquiry form creates an email draft in your browser. It does not send your information to LZZ or upload drawings. To contact us, open the draft in your email app, add your attachments and send it yourself.

Saved drafts

Your input is kept in this browser tab so you can continue after a refresh. The draft is associated with the part or topic used when you entered the form. Changing the product or service inside the form updates that same draft; it does not create a separate saved copy. These details are not sent to LZZ or saved to an account.

Select “Clear saved input” to remove the draft for the current entry context, including older copies associated with that entry. A browser that restores an earlier session may also restore your draft. Clear your input when using a shared device.

If storage is blocked or full, you can still prepare a draft while the page is open, then choose “Save draft” to keep a text copy.

Cookies and external services

This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Your email provider, WhatsApp and other linked websites have their own privacy policies.

Product and company information

Product pages describe example parts and the information needed to quote a similar component. They are not independently verified specifications for the pictured parts. Your drawing and quotation define the material and tolerances, with inspection and commercial terms confirmed for your order. Original catalog records are retained in our archive.

The engineering guides help you prepare an inquiry. They contain no customer inspection results and do not establish suitability for a particular application. English summaries explain the company documents; contact LZZ to verify their current validity. Inspection planning is agreed for your order.
